glass: tall highball glass (about 300 ml), filled with ice
version: v1 (round 4, 2026-09-30): a mezcal Paloma (Oxford PALOMA pdf 1470; Codex p. 212 recommends the mezcal version), built in the glass. Del Maguey Chichicapa recommended (one of Cooper's first two village bottlings, Oxford COOPER pdf 573, Proper p. 248; the jug poured away at the border, Hester F18). Spark: a honey from where the guest lives, as honey syrup, is about three-quarters of the drink's sugar (Matrix pdf 148: honey varies by source, many are blended; citrus its first best pairing; mezcal on the honey chart, pdf 149, Smoke segment). The soda is built from fresh grapefruit juice, sparkling water and the honey (Oxford pdf 1470: craft bartenders use juice, sugar and sparkling water; the honey is ours).
